paragraphs: Bava ben Buta, a Tanna; Beitzah 20a.
Levi bar Buti, in the time of Rav Huna; Megillah 31b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Megillah 31b explicitly has Levi bar Buti reading before Rav Huna; this supports the expansion of ר״ה here.

The whole Davidson Beitzah 20a paragraph names Bava ben Buta, while the whole Megillah 31b paragraph gives Levi bar Buti reading before Rav Huna. The local full Rav Huna expansion is supported and the current note remains verbatim. The Tanna qualifier remains attached to Hyman’s first pointer; the two names do not prove one father or any new chronology binding.
